0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (0-2, 12th in the East, 1.5 games back in the Southeast) are on a two-game losing streak, while the Toronto Raptors (2-0, 3rd in the East, 0.5 games back in the Atlantic) have won two straight, going 1-0 at home and 1-0 on the road. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee) and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee, inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Magic lost 1-2 in the series, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto in the regular season on March 29, 2026.
